English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # Antigravity Account Switcher [![CI](https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Node.js >= 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D%2018-339933) ![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-0-brightgreen) A cross-platform auxiliary-pane sidecar plugin (`SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`) for **Google Antigravity 2.0** that manages multiple local OAuth accounts, encrypts credentials at rest, displays per-account quota usage, and switches accounts cleanly across desktop and WSL2 environments — built on **Node.js >= 18** with **zero external npm dependencies**.

## Supported Platforms | Platform | Runtime Mode | Antigravity Host & Language Server | Verification Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Windows (native)** | `win32` | Windows Electron desktop + `language_server.exe` (PE64 x64 / ARM64) | Live desktop verified + CI (`windows-latest`) | | **WSL2 + Windows host** | `wsl` | WSL2 Linux `language_server` (ELF64 x64 / ARM64) + Windows Electron host via `/mnt/c/Windows/System32` | Live WSL2 + Windows host verified | | **Linux (desktop)** | `linux` | Native Linux Antigravity desktop + `language_server` (ELF64 x64 / ARM64) | Verified in CI (`ubuntu-latest`) | | **macOS** | `darwin` | `Antigravity.app` (Intel x64, Apple Silicon ARM64, and Universal Fat Mach-O) | Verified in CI (`macos-latest`); physical desktop testing welcome | ## Features - **Current Account Inspection & Masked Display**: Reads the active session token from OS Keyring on **macOS** (Keychain `gemini`/`antigravity`) and **Linux desktop** (Secret Service via `secret-tool` when `DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS` is set), or from `~/.gemini/jetski-standalone-oauth-token` on **WSL2** and non-keyring environments. On **native Windows** (zero background PowerShell subprocesses), combines `LanguageServerService/GetUserStatus` with the encrypted vault to show active sign-in status cleanly and relies on **`+ Add Account`** to enroll accounts. Emails are masked by default with a one-click header toggle to reveal full addresses. - **No-Logout Browser OAuth Addition (`+ Add Account`)**: - Dynamically extracts the official OAuth client configuration at runtime from your local Antigravity `language_server` / `language_server.exe` binary (**ELF64**, **PE64**, and single/Universal Fat **Mach-O 64-bit** — zero client secrets stored in this repository). - Runs a Google OAuth 2.0 **PKCE S256** flow with a `127.0.0.1:0` loopback callback, single-use constant-time (`timingSafeEqual`) `state` verification, and a 5-minute TTL. - Displays a copyable authorization URL so you can sign in inside an incognito window or another browser profile without signing out of your active Antigravity session. - Includes **Native Sign-in (Fallback)** in Tools for environments where browser OAuth is blocked (backs up the active account, quits the desktop app, and relaunches signed out). - **Non-Active Tier Sync & Per-Account `View usage` Panel**: - Automatically resolves subscription tiers (`Google AI Pro`, `Google AI Ultra`, `Free`, etc.) via `v1internal:loadCodeAssist` upon browser OAuth addition, background fill for uncached accounts, and header Refresh — without switching accounts or altering last-used timestamps. - Each saved account card includes a collapsible **`View usage`** panel rendering Antigravity-style quota groups and circular rings (querying local `language_server` `RetrieveUserQuotaSummary` directly for the active account with remote `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary` fallback for non-active accounts, using `antigravity/hub/` headers so advanced model groups such as Argon/Carbon stay intact). - Smart caching & refresh: initial expansion after opening/reopening the sidebar honors the `30s` backend cache; re-expanding within the same session automatically refreshes when more than `10s` have elapsed since the last successful fetch (reusing loaded data within `10s`); staying expanded leaves refreshes to the manual refresh controls. - **Automatic HTTP Proxy Support**: - Honors `HTTPS_PROXY` / `https_proxy`, `HTTP_PROXY` / `http_proxy`, and `NO_PROXY` / `no_proxy`. - **Node.js >= 24.5 or >= 22.21**: Uses Node's native `https.Agent({ proxyEnv })` directly without needing `--use-env-proxy` in `sidecar.json`, keeping Node 18/20/22/24 startup uniform. - **Node.js 18 / 20 / earlier 22**: Automatically falls back to the built-in `ProxyConnectAgent`, establishing an HTTP `CONNECT` tunnel (including Basic `Proxy-Authorization` credentials and `NO_PROXY` bypass matching) and upgrading to TLS >= 1.2 with strict certificate verification. - **AES-256-GCM Encrypted Vault**: - Encrypts saved accounts (`vault.enc.json`), automatic pre-switch active-token backups (`last-token.enc.json`), and single-use switch jobs (`jobs/job-.enc.json`) with a local 256-bit random master key (`vault.key`). - Enforces `0700` directory permissions and `0600` file permissions on Unix (WSL2, macOS, and Linux). - **Keep In Menu Bar Adaptive Fast Shutdown & Relaunch**: - Executes switches in a detached worker (`switcher-worker.mjs`: pure Node.js double-fork `--detach-worker` on native Windows outside the `Antigravity.exe` tree, or `systemd-run --user --scope` on Linux/WSL2 when available — zero hidden `powershell.exe` calls). - On **Windows / WSL2**, reads `app_storage.json` (`runInBackground` — Antigravity's *Keep In Menu Bar* setting) and inspects `tasklist /V /FO CSV` to identify visible main `Antigravity.exe` windows, closes them first before cleaning up tray processes (native Windows omits `/T`), and signals WSL2 `language_server` (`SIGTERM`) to flush cleanly. On native Windows, clears the active `gemini:antigravity` Credential Manager entry via `cmdkey.exe` and writes `~/.gemini/jetski-standalone-oauth-token` (which `language_server.exe` imports on startup), then relaunches via `%APPDATA%\Antigravity\launch-env-proxy.vbs` (optional proxy wrapper if present), `Antigravity.exe`, or `ANTIGRAVITY_SWITCHER_RELAUNCH_EXE`. - On **macOS**, quits cleanly via `/usr/bin/osascript` (`SIGTERM` fallback) and relaunches via `/usr/bin/open -a`. - On **Linux**, terminates desktop and `language_server` processes via `SIGTERM` and relaunches the captured desktop binary. - **Pre-Switch Active-Work Guard & Bilingual UI (`中 / EN`)**: - Checks `GetAllCascadeTrajectories`, `ListBackgroundTasks`, and `ListTerminals` via `language_server` RPC plus active user child processes before switching; pauses with **Recheck & Switch**, **Cancel**, or audited **Force Switch** (`FORCE_SWITCH_REQUESTED` in `switch.log`) when work is running. - Built-in instant **`中 / EN`** toggle switches all in-panel UI copy immediately. ## Scope, Boundaries & Known Limitations 1. **Consumer Accounts Only**: Only personal Google accounts (`auth_method: "consumer"`) are supported; enterprise / Google Workspace SSO tokens are rejected. 2. **Restart Required on Switch**: Antigravity holds the active OAuth session in its running `language_server` process, so switching accounts requires quitting Antigravity, waiting for `language_server` to flush and exit, swapping credentials, and relaunching the app. Always finish or acknowledge running tasks before switching. 3. **Platform Verification & Windows Credential Reading**: - **Windows (native)** & **WSL2 + Windows host** have been verified end-to-end on real desktops. On native Windows, this plugin deliberately avoids launching hidden PowerShell/WMI commands to read Credential Manager (preventing security-suite false positives); enroll accounts already signed in on Windows once via **`+ Add Account`**. - **Linux (desktop)** & **macOS** pass full unit/integration CI suites (`ubuntu-latest`, `macos-latest`), while physical macOS desktop GUI switching has not yet been manually tested on real Apple hardware — issue reports and PRs from macOS users are very welcome. 4. **Local Binary Extraction Dependency**: Zero OAuth client secrets are bundled; the plugin extracts client credentials at runtime from your local `language_server` binary. If a future Antigravity update moves the binary or changes its compiled layout, set `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENTAPI_EXE` or use **`Native Sign-in (Fallback)`**. 5. **Static Manifest Display Name**: Antigravity's `plugin.json` and `sidecar.json` currently accept static strings only (no OS-locale manifest switching), so the Plugins manager entry and side-pane tab always display **`Account Switcher`**, while all content inside the panel supports **`中 / EN`** switching. 6. **Quota & Tier Endpoints**: Tier sync and non-active quota views depend on Google Cloud Code endpoints (`v1internal:loadCodeAssist`, `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary`, `30 req/min` rate limit). Upstream API changes or proxy network errors may prevent tier/quota updates while leaving local account switching unaffected. 7. **Independent Community Project**: This is an independent open-source plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. All credentials remain encrypted locally on your machine. ## Requirements - **Node.js >= 18** (`node` binary must be on the `PATH` visible to Antigravity's `language_server`). - **Zero npm packages**: No `npm install` step is required. > **Important `PATH` note for Unix (WSL2 / macOS / Linux):** > Antigravity's `language_server` may run outside your interactive shell environment and might not load `~/.bashrc`, `~/.zshrc`, or `nvm` initialization scripts. Ensure `node` is available on a standard system `PATH` directory (such as `/usr/local/bin/node`, or `/opt/homebrew/bin/node` on macOS if inherited by GUI apps). On Windows, ensure `node.exe` is on your User or System `PATH`. ## Installation ### Option A: Clone Directly into the Global Plugins Folder (Recommended) - **Unix (WSL2 / macOS / Linux)**: ```bash git clone https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-account-switcher ``` - **Windows (PowerShell or CMD)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-account-switcher" ``` ### Option B: Clone Elsewhere & Register via `plugins.json` 1. Clone this repository into any directory (for example `/path/to/antigravity-plugins/antigravity-account-switcher`). 2. Add the parent directory and `"include_only": ["antigravity-account-switcher"]` to `plugins.json` (merge into existing arrays if present): - **Unix (WSL2 / macOS / Linux)** — `~/.gemini/config/plugins.json`: ```json { "entries": [ { "path": "/path/to/antigravity-plugins", "include_only": [ "antigravity-account-switcher" ] } ] } ``` - **Windows** — `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins.json`: ```json { "entries": [ { "path": "C:\\path\\to\\antigravity-plugins", "include_only": [ "antigravity-account-switcher" ] } ] } ``` 3. **Restart Antigravity** and open the **`Account Switcher`** tab in the right auxiliary pane (also reachable via the **Plugins** page). ## Optional Environment Variables | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` | HTTP proxy and bypass rules for Google OAuth token exchange and Cloud Code requests (lowercase variants also supported). | | `ANTIGRAVITY_SWITCHER_RELAUNCH_EXE` | Custom executable path (or `.vbs` launcher on Windows/WSL2) used to relaunch Antigravity after switching. | | `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENTAPI_EXE` | Overrides the `language_server` binary path used for OAuth client extraction (also used on macOS to locate the `.app` bundle). | | `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_STORAGE_PATH` | Overrides the path to `app_storage.json` (`runInBackground` detection). | | `ANTIGRAVITY_WIN_APPDATA` / `ANTIGRAVITY_WIN_LOCALAPPDATA` | Overrides Windows `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%` discovery under WSL2 when Windows interop or `PATH` inference is unavailable. | | `ANTIGRAVITY_GEMINI_DIR` / `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR` | Overrides `~/.gemini` and the encrypted sidecar data directory. | ## Runtime Data Directory Runtime data is completely separated from plugin source files. Under Antigravity 2.0 (`ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR`), data lives at `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-account-switcher/switcher/data/` (or `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity\sidecar_data\antigravity-account-switcher\switcher\data\` on Windows; standalone fallback is `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/antigravity-account-switcher/`): - `vault.key` — Randomly generated 256-bit AES master key (`0600` on Unix) - `vault.enc.json` — AES-256-GCM encrypted account vault (`0600` on Unix) - `last-token.enc.json` — AES-256-GCM encrypted backup of the active token captured before switching (`0600` on Unix) - `jobs/job-.enc.json` — Single-use encrypted switch job deleted immediately upon worker pickup - `switch.log` — Sanitized audit and diagnostic log (masked emails and error codes only; never logs tokens or secrets) ## Security Architecture - **Token Gate & Rate Limiting**: All API endpoints require the host-injected `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_UI_TOKEN` (`403` when absent) and enforce sliding-window rate limits (`60 req/min` reads, `10 req/min` writes, `30 req/min` tier/usage queries) plus a `15s` switch lock. - **Strict CSP & DOM-Safe Frontend**: Responses include `Content-Security-Policy` (`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'`), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and `Permissions-Policy`. The web UI uses `textContent` and DOM builders exclusively (no `innerHTML`, `eval`, or inline scripts/styles). - **Cryptographic Integrity (Fail-Closed)**: Every encrypted envelope uses AES-256-GCM with a unique 12-byte IV and 16-byte authentication tag; any tampering rejects decryption. - **Filesystem & Process Hardening**: Rejects symlinks (`lstatSync`) on sensitive files and directories, enforces path-boundary containment (`assertInsideDir`), writes atomically via temp file + `renameSync`, validates UUIDs, strips prototype-pollution keys (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`), and invokes child processes strictly with argument arrays (`execFileSync` / `spawn`, never `shell: true`). Active-process inspection logs only executable basename + PID to avoid exposing command-line arguments. - **OAuth & Cloud Code Hardening**: Extracts client credentials dynamically from the local signed binary, enforces PKCE S256 + `crypto.timingSafeEqual` single-use `state`, binds callback only on `127.0.0.1:0` with immediate listener teardown, serves static `default-src 'none'` callback pages, enforces TLS >= 1.2 (`rejectUnauthorized: true`), and restricts outbound HTTPS requests strictly to `oauth2.googleapis.com`, `www.googleapis.com`, `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`, and `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`. ## Repository Structure - `plugin.json` — Plugin manifest (`antigravity-account-switcher`, display name `Account Switcher`) - `assets/logo.svg` — Plugin icon - `sidecars/switcher/sidecar.json` — Sidecar entrypoint (`command: "node"`, `args: ["main.mjs"]`, `SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`) - `sidecars/switcher/main.mjs` — Sidecar HTTP server, API routes, security gates, and rate limiting - `sidecars/switcher/platform.mjs` — Cross-platform runtime detection, path translation, binary discovery, browser launch, and Antigravity relaunch - `sidecars/switcher/binary-oauth.mjs` — ELF64, PE64, and Mach-O 64-bit / Universal Fat binary OAuth client extractor - `sidecars/switcher/oauth.mjs` — PKCE S256 loopback OAuth manager & dual-mode proxy HTTPS client - `sidecars/switcher/cloudcode.mjs` — Subscription tier sync (`loadCodeAssist`), quota summary retrieval (`retrieveUserQuotaSummary` / local LS), and OAuth token refresh helper - `sidecars/switcher/vault.mjs` — AES-256-GCM vault, atomic file writes, symlink/boundary guards, and token normalization - `sidecars/switcher/token-store.mjs` — Cross-platform token store (macOS Keychain & Linux Secret Service keyring, Windows `cmdkey.exe` + file handoff, and WSL2 file store) - `sidecars/switcher/active-work.mjs` — Pre-switch RPC and user child-process detector - `sidecars/switcher/switcher-worker.mjs` — Detached switch and desktop restart worker - `sidecars/switcher/public/` — Auxiliary-pane web UI (`index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`) - `sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs` — Isolated unit and integration test suite ## Running Tests Run the test suite on Node.js >= 18: ```bash node --test sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs ``` On Node.js >= 24.5, also verify native proxy mode with `--use-env-proxy`: ```bash node --use-env-proxy --test sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs ``` Run syntax checks across all `.mjs` modules and frontend script: ```bash for f in sidecars/switcher/*.mjs sidecars/switcher/test/*.mjs sidecars/switcher/public/app.js; do node --check "$f"; done ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | 简体中文 # Antigravity Account Switcher（Antigravity 多账号切换插件） [![CI](https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Node.js >= 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D%2018-339933) ![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-0-brightgreen) 适用于 **Google Antigravity 2.0** 的跨平台原生侧栏（`SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`）多账号管理与切换插件：支持免退出浏览器 OAuth 添加账号、AES-256-GCM 静态加密存储、不切号同步订阅等级与分账号用量查看，以及安全切号重启。基于 **Node.js >= 18** 开发，**零外部 npm 依赖**。

## 支持平台 | 平台 | 运行时标识 | 宿主桌面端与 Language Server | 验证情况 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Windows 原生** | `win32` | Windows Electron 桌面端 + `language_server.exe`（PE64 x64 / ARM64） | 已真机实测 + CI 验证（`windows-latest`） | | **WSL2 + Windows 宿主** | `wsl` | WSL2 Linux `language_server`（ELF64 x64 / ARM64）+ 通过 `/mnt/c/Windows/System32` 协同的 Windows Electron 宿主 | 已 WSL2 + Windows 宿主双端实测 | | **Linux 桌面** | `linux` | 原生 Linux Antigravity 桌面端 + `language_server`（ELF64 x64 / ARM64） | 已通过 CI 验证（`ubuntu-latest`） | | **macOS** | `darwin` | `Antigravity.app`（支持 Intel x64、Apple Silicon ARM64 与 Universal Fat Mach-O） | 已通过 CI 验证（`macos-latest`）；欢迎真机反馈 | ## 功能特性 - **当前账号状态识别与脱敏展示**：在 **macOS**（Keychain `gemini`/`antigravity`）与 **桌面 Linux**（存在 `DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS` 时通过 `secret-tool`）自动读取系统凭据库，在 **WSL2** 与无桌面凭据库环境读取 `~/.gemini/jetski-standalone-oauth-token`；在 **Windows 原生**下零 PowerShell 子进程（避免触发安全软件拦截），结合 `LanguageServerService/GetUserStatus` RPC 与加密切换库直接展示当前已登录账号状态，并通过「**+ 添加账号**」免退出纳入切换列表。邮箱默认脱敏显示（支持顶部一键切换完整邮箱显示）。 - **免退出浏览器直接添加账号（`+ 添加账号`）**： - 运行时从本机 Antigravity `language_server` / `language_server.exe` 二进制文件中动态提取官方 OAuth 客户端配置（支持 **ELF64**、**PE64** 及单架构/通用 **Mach-O 64-bit**，仓库内零硬编码密钥）。 - 使用 `127.0.0.1:0` 回环监听 + **PKCE S256** + 恒定时间比较（`timingSafeEqual`）的单次 `state` 校验（有效期 5 分钟）。 - 唤起系统浏览器并展示可复制授权链接，可粘贴至无痕窗口或其他浏览器配置文件中登录新账号，无需退出当前 Antigravity 会话。 - 在「高级工具」中保留「**原生登录（备用）**」：当浏览器直接授权受阻时，自动备份当前账号并退出桌面应用，以未登录状态重开窗口进行原生登录。 - **不切号同步订阅等级与分账号用量（`查看用量`）**： - 支持在浏览器 OAuth 添加、后台补全缺失等级及点击顶部刷新时，通过 `v1internal:loadCodeAssist` 自动同步各账号的订阅等级（如 `Google AI Pro` / `Google AI Ultra` / `Free`），不切换当前登录态也不改动「上次使用」时间。 - 每个已保存账号卡片底部提供可展开的「**查看用量**（View usage）」面板，渲染与 Antigravity 原生一致的分组配额与环形进度条（当前活跃账号优先直连本地 `language_server` `RetrieveUserQuotaSummary`，非活跃账号通过加密凭据请求 `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary`，发送 `antigravity/hub/` User-Agent 保留 Argon/Carbon 等进阶模型分组）。 - 智能缓存与节流：首次展开或关闭重开侧栏后首次展开优先命中 `30 秒` 后端缓存（超时则拉最新）；同一会话内折叠后再次展开若距上次成功刷新超过 `10 秒` 会自动强制刷新（`10 秒` 内复用已加载结果）；卡片保持展开期间不自动轮询，交由顶部总刷新或卡片内刷新按钮手动刷新。 - **自动 HTTP 代理支持**： - 自动读取标准环境变量 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `https_proxy`、`HTTP_PROXY` / `http_proxy` 与 `NO_PROXY` / `no_proxy`。 - **Node.js >= 24.5 或 >= 22.21**：直接使用 Node 原生 `https.Agent({ proxyEnv })`，无需在 `sidecar.json` 中写死 `--use-env-proxy`，保证 Node 18/20/22/24 启动方式统一。 - **Node.js 18 / 20 / 早期 22**：自动回退至内置 `ProxyConnectAgent`，通过 `http://` 代理建立 `CONNECT` 隧道（支持代理 URL 中的 Basic `Proxy-Authorization` 凭据及 `NO_PROXY` 域名后缀/通配匹配），并在隧道上升级为开启严格证书校验的 TLS >= 1.2 连接。 - **AES-256-GCM 静态加密凭据库**： - 使用随机生成的本机 256 位主密钥（`vault.key`）加密保存账号库（`vault.enc.json`）、切号前自动备份的活跃凭证（`last-token.enc.json`）与单次切号任务（`jobs/job-.enc.json`）。 - 在 Unix 系统（WSL2 / macOS / Linux）下强制以 `0700` 数据目录权限与 `0600` 文件权限原子写入。 - **Keep In Menu Bar 自适应快速重启**： - 通过脱离进程树的独立执行器（`switcher-worker.mjs`；原生 Windows 下采用纯 Node.js 双派生 `--detach-worker` 跳板切断父进程链，Linux/WSL2 下优先通过 `systemd-run --user --scope` 托管，全程零隐藏 PowerShell）执行闭环切号。 - 在 **Windows / WSL2** 下，读取 `app_storage.json` 中的 `runInBackground`（即 *Keep In Menu Bar* 设置）并通过 `tasklist /V /FO CSV` 识别可见主窗口 `Antigravity.exe` PID，先温和关闭可见窗口再清理托盘残留进程（原生 Windows 不传 `/T`），并在 WSL2 中提前向 `language_server` 发送 `SIGTERM` 落盘退出；原生 Windows 下通过系统内置 `cmdkey.exe` 清除旧的 `gemini:antigravity` 凭据后写入 `~/.gemini/jetski-standalone-oauth-token`（供 `language_server.exe` 启动时自动迁回凭据管理器），再优先通过 `%APPDATA%\Antigravity\launch-env-proxy.vbs`（可选代理启动脚本，存在时使用）、`Antigravity.exe` 或 `ANTIGRAVITY_SWITCHER_RELAUNCH_EXE` 重开应用。 - 在 **macOS** 下，先通过 `/usr/bin/osascript` 请求优雅退出（超时后回退 `SIGTERM`），完成后通过 `/usr/bin/open -a` 重启应用。 - 在 **Linux** 下，向桌面端与 `language_server` 发送 `SIGTERM` 并重启捕获到的可执行文件。 - **切号前活跃任务护栏与内置双语界面（`中 / EN`）**： - 切号前探测 `language_server` RPC（`GetAllCascadeTrajectories`、`ListBackgroundTasks`、`ListTerminals`）并扫描用户子进程（自动排除 Sidecar 与常驻 MCP 服务等基础设施进程）；若检测到活跃任务，默认返回 `HTTP 409` 并提供「重新检查并切换」「取消」及记入审计日志（`FORCE_SWITCH_REQUESTED`）的「仍要强制切换」。 - 面板右上角支持一键 **`中 / EN`** 实时切换界面语言。 ## 功能边界与已知限制 1. **仅支持个人消费者账号**：只支持个人版 Google 账号（`auth_method: "consumer"`），企业版 / Google Workspace SSO 凭据会被拒绝。 2. **切换账号需要重启桌面应用**：Antigravity 的登录态常驻于运行中的 `language_server` 进程内，切号必须先退出桌面端、等待 `language_server` 落盘退出后再替换凭据并重新打开窗口。切号前请先结束或确认运行中的对话/终端任务。 3. **跨平台实测范围与 Windows 凭据读取策略**： - **Windows 原生**与 **WSL2 + Windows 宿主**已完成真机端到端实测。为避免触发杀毒软件拦截，Windows 原生端刻意不调用 PowerShell 读取凭据管理器，因此若你已在 Windows 桌面登录了现有账号，首次使用请通过右上角「**+ 添加账号**」完成授权入库。 - **Linux 桌面**与 **macOS** 已在 GitHub Actions CI（`ubuntu-latest`、`macos-latest`）通过全套单元测试与集成测试，其中 **macOS** 真实桌面环境的实际切号重启流程暂未在物理 Mac 上手动验证，欢迎 macOS 用户反馈或提 PR。 4. **依赖本地二进制提取客户端配置**：仓库内不包含任何 OAuth 密钥，运行时动态从本机 `language_server` 读取官方客户端配置。若未来 Antigravity 升级调整了二进制结构或安装路径，可通过环境变量 `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENTAPI_EXE` 指定路径，或使用「**原生登录（备用）**」兜底。 5. **插件/标签页外层标题为静态英文**：Antigravity 宿主目前的 `plugin.json` 与 `sidecar.json` 清单仅支持静态字符串（不支持随系统语言动态切换清单标题），因此插件管理页与右侧标签页统一显示为 **`Account Switcher`**，面板内部文案可自由切换 **`中 / EN`**。 6. **订阅等级与用量查询可用性**：依赖本地 `language_server` 与 Google Cloud Code 接口（`v1internal:loadCodeAssist`、`v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary`，限流 `30 次/分`）。若遇上游接口变更或网络/代理受阻，等级同步和用量展示可能失败，但不会影响本地账号库管理与正常切号。 7. **独立开源插件**：本项目为独立社区插件，与 Google 无隶属关系；所有账号凭据仅以加密形式保存在你本地设备中。 ## 运行环境要求 - **Node.js >= 18**（且 `node` 必须位于 Antigravity `language_server` 可见的 `PATH` 中）。 - **零外部依赖**：无需执行 `npm install`。 > **Unix（WSL2 / macOS / Linux）`PATH` 重要提示：** > Antigravity 的 `language_server` 通常由桌面端或非交互环境启动，可能不会加载 `~/.bashrc`、`~/.zshrc` 或 `nvm` 初始化脚本。请确保将 `node` 安装或软链到系统标准 `PATH` 目录（例如 Unix 下的 `/usr/local/bin/node`，或 macOS GUI 可继承的 `/opt/homebrew/bin/node`）。在 Windows 下请确保 `node.exe` 已加入用户或系统 `PATH`。 ## 安装与启用 ### 方式一：直接克隆到全局插件目录（推荐） - **Unix（WSL2 / macOS / Linux）**： ```bash git clone https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-account-switcher ``` - **Windows（PowerShell）**： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-account-switcher" ``` ### 方式二：克隆到自定义目录并通过 `plugins.json` 注册 1. 克隆仓库到本地任意目录（例如 `/path/to/antigravity-plugins/antigravity-account-switcher`）。 2. 在 `plugins.json` 中填入仓库的**上级目录**，并在 `include_only` 中指定 `"antigravity-account-switcher"`（若文件已存在，请合并到现有数组中）： - **Unix（WSL2 / macOS / Linux）** — `~/.gemini/config/plugins.json`： ```json { "entries": [ { "path": "/path/to/antigravity-plugins", "include_only": [ "antigravity-account-switcher" ] } ] } ``` - **Windows** — `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins.json`： ```json { "entries": [ { "path": "C:\\path\\to\\antigravity-plugins", "include_only": [ "antigravity-account-switcher" ] } ] } ``` 3. **重启 Antigravity**（或重新加载插件），在右侧辅助面板打开「**Account Switcher**」标签页即可使用。 ## 可选环境变量 | 环境变量 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` | 控制 Google OAuth 令牌换取与 Cloud Code 接口请求的 HTTP 代理及绕过规则（同时支持小写变量）。 | | `ANTIGRAVITY_SWITCHER_RELAUNCH_EXE` | 自定义切号后重启 Antigravity 的可执行文件路径（Windows/WSL2 下亦支持 `.vbs` 启动脚本）。 | | `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENTAPI_EXE` | 显式指定用于提取 OAuth 客户端配置的 `language_server` 路径（macOS 下亦用于定位 `.app` 目录）。 | | `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_STORAGE_PATH` | 覆盖 `app_storage.json` 的探测路径（用于读取 `runInBackground`）。 | | `ANTIGRAVITY_WIN_APPDATA` / `ANTIGRAVITY_WIN_LOCALAPPDATA` | 在非标准 WSL2 环境下覆盖 Windows `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%` 路径解析。 | | `ANTIGRAVITY_GEMINI_DIR` / `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR` | 覆盖 `~/.gemini` 与 Sidecar 运行时加密数据目录。 | ## 运行时数据目录 运行时数据与插件源码完全隔离。在 Antigravity 2.0 中默认由 `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR` 指向 `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-account-switcher/switcher/data/`（Windows 下为 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity\sidecar_data\antigravity-account-switcher\switcher\data\`；独立运行时默认回退至 `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/antigravity-account-switcher/`）： - `vault.key` — 随机生成的 256 位 AES 主密钥（Unix 下 `0600`） - `vault.enc.json` — AES-256-GCM 加密的已保存账号库（Unix 下 `0600`） - `last-token.enc.json` — 切号前自动备份的活跃凭证密文（Unix 下 `0600`） - `jobs/job-.enc.json` — 单次加密切号任务（由 `switcher-worker.mjs` 读取后立即删除） - `switch.log` — 脱敏的切号、OAuth 错误码与强制切换审计日志（不含任何明文邮箱或令牌） ## 安全架构 - **令牌门禁与速率限制**：所有 API 均校验宿主注入的 `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_UI_TOKEN`（缺失时返回 `403`），并启用滑动窗口限流（读接口 `60 次/分`，写接口 `10 次/分`，等级与用量查询接口 `30 次/分`）与 `15 秒` 切号互斥锁。 - **严格响应头与无注入前端**：HTTP 响应附带 `Content-Security-Policy`（`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'`）、`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`、`Cache-Control: no-store`、`Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` 与 `Permissions-Policy`。前端全部使用 `textContent` 与标准 DOM API 构建，无 `innerHTML`、`eval` 或内联脚本/样式。 - **加密完整性校验（Fail-Closed）**：每条密文均采用 AES-256-GCM 配合 12 字节随机 IV 与 16 字节认证标签，任何篡改都会直接拒绝解密。 - **文件系统与进程安全**：对敏感文件及目录执行 `lstatSync` 符号链接拦截与 `assertInsideDir` 边界校验，采用临时文件 + `renameSync` 原子落盘，严格校验 UUID 与过滤原型链污染键（`__proto__`、`constructor`、`prototype`）；子进程调用一律使用 `execFileSync` / `spawn` 参数数组（禁用 `shell: true`），子进程检测仅记录可执行文件名与 PID 以避免命令行参数泄露。 - **OAuth 与远端接口安全加固**：凭据从本机签名二进制动态提取、强制 PKCE S256 与 `crypto.timingSafeEqual` 单次 `state` 校验、仅监听 `127.0.0.1:0` 并在回调后立即关闭监听、静态回调页启用 `default-src 'none'` CSP、出站 HTTPS 强制 TLS >= 1.2 与证书校验，出站主机严格白名单限制为 `oauth2.googleapis.com`、`www.googleapis.com`、`daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` 与 `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`。 ## 仓库结构 - `plugin.json` — 插件清单（`antigravity-account-switcher`，显示名 `Account Switcher`） - `assets/logo.svg` — 插件图标 - `sidecars/switcher/sidecar.json` — Sidecar 入口定义（`command: "node"`、`args: ["main.mjs"]`、`SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`） - `sidecars/switcher/main.mjs` — Sidecar HTTP 服务、API 路由、安全门禁与限流 - `sidecars/switcher/platform.mjs` — 跨平台运行时检测、路径转换、二进制发现、浏览器唤起与桌面端重启 - `sidecars/switcher/binary-oauth.mjs` — ELF64 / PE64 / Mach-O 64-bit（含 Universal Fat）OAuth 客户端提取器 - `sidecars/switcher/oauth.mjs` — PKCE S256 回环 OAuth 管理器与双模式代理 HTTPS 客户端 - `sidecars/switcher/cloudcode.mjs` — 订阅等级同步（`loadCodeAssist`）、用量配额查询（`retrieveUserQuotaSummary` / 本地 LS 快速通道）与 OAuth 令牌刷新封装 - `sidecars/switcher/vault.mjs` — AES-256-GCM 凭据库、原子写入、符号链接/路径边界防护与凭证标准化 - `sidecars/switcher/token-store.mjs` — 跨平台凭据读写层（macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service、Windows `cmdkey.exe` + 文件交接与 WSL2 文件存储） - `sidecars/switcher/active-work.mjs` — 切号前 RPC 与用户子进程活跃探测器 - `sidecars/switcher/switcher-worker.mjs` — 脱离进程树的独立切号与重启执行器 - `sidecars/switcher/public/` — 侧栏 Web UI（`index.html`、`app.js`、`styles.css`） - `sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs` — 全隔离单元测试与集成测试套件 ## 验证与测试 在 Node.js >= 18 下运行测试套件： ```bash node --test sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs ``` 在 Node.js >= 24.5 下同时验证 `--use-env-proxy` 原生代理模式： ```bash node --use-env-proxy --test sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs ``` 对所有 `.mjs` 模块与前端脚本执行语法检查： ```bash for f in sidecars/switcher/*.mjs sidecars/switcher/test/*.mjs sidecars/switcher/public/app.js; do node --check "$f"; done ``` ## 开源许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # Antigravity Account Switcher [![CI](https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Node.js >= 18](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D%2018-339933) ![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-0-brightgreen) A cross-platform auxiliary-pane sidecar plugin (`SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`) for **Google Antigravity 2.0** that manages multiple local OAuth accounts, encrypts credentials at rest, displays per-account quota usage, and switches accounts cleanly across desktop and WSL2 environments — built on **Node.js >= 18** with **zero external npm dependencies**.

## Supported Platforms | Platform | Runtime Mode | Antigravity Host & Language Server | Verification Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Windows (native)** | `win32` | Windows Electron desktop + `language_server.exe` (PE64 x64 / ARM64) | Live desktop verified + CI (`windows-latest`) | | **WSL2 + Windows host** | `wsl` | WSL2 Linux `language_server` (ELF64 x64 / ARM64) + Windows Electron host via `/mnt/c/Windows/System32` | Live WSL2 + Windows host verified | | **Linux (desktop)** | `linux` | Native Linux Antigravity desktop + `language_server` (ELF64 x64 / ARM64) | Verified in CI (`ubuntu-latest`) | | **macOS** | `darwin` | `Antigravity.app` (Intel x64, Apple Silicon ARM64, and Universal Fat Mach-O) | Verified in CI (`macos-latest`); physical desktop testing welcome | ## Features - **Current Account Inspection & Masked Display**: Reads the active session token from OS Keyring on **macOS** (Keychain `gemini`/`antigravity`) and **Linux desktop** (Secret Service via `secret-tool` when `DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS` is set), or from `~/.gemini/jetski-standalone-oauth-token` on **WSL2** and non-keyring environments. On **native Windows** (zero background PowerShell subprocesses), combines `LanguageServerService/GetUserStatus` with the encrypted vault to show active sign-in status cleanly and relies on **`+ Add Account`** to enroll accounts. Emails are masked by default with a one-click header toggle to reveal full addresses. - **No-Logout Browser OAuth Addition (`+ Add Account`)**: - Dynamically extracts the official OAuth client configuration at runtime from your local Antigravity `language_server` / `language_server.exe` binary (**ELF64**, **PE64**, and single/Universal Fat **Mach-O 64-bit** — zero client secrets stored in this repository). - Runs a Google OAuth 2.0 **PKCE S256** flow with a `127.0.0.1:0` loopback callback, single-use constant-time (`timingSafeEqual`) `state` verification, and a 5-minute TTL. - Displays a copyable authorization URL so you can sign in inside an incognito window or another browser profile without signing out of your active Antigravity session. - Includes **Native Sign-in (Fallback)** in Tools for environments where browser OAuth is blocked (backs up the active account, quits the desktop app, and relaunches signed out). - **Non-Active Tier Sync & Per-Account `View usage` Panel**: - Automatically resolves subscription tiers (`Google AI Pro`, `Google AI Ultra`, `Free`, etc.) via `v1internal:loadCodeAssist` upon browser OAuth addition, background fill for uncached accounts, and header Refresh — without switching accounts or altering last-used timestamps. - Each saved account card includes a collapsible **`View usage`** panel rendering Antigravity-style quota groups and circular rings (querying local `language_server` `RetrieveUserQuotaSummary` directly for the active account with remote `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary` fallback for non-active accounts, using `antigravity/hub/` headers so advanced model groups such as Argon/Carbon stay intact). - Smart caching & refresh: initial expansion after opening/reopening the sidebar honors the `30s` backend cache; re-expanding within the same session automatically refreshes when more than `10s` have elapsed since the last successful fetch (reusing loaded data within `10s`); staying expanded leaves refreshes to the manual refresh controls. - **Automatic HTTP Proxy Support**: - Honors `HTTPS_PROXY` / `https_proxy`, `HTTP_PROXY` / `http_proxy`, and `NO_PROXY` / `no_proxy`. - **Node.js >= 24.5 or >= 22.21**: Uses Node's native `https.Agent({ proxyEnv })` directly without needing `--use-env-proxy` in `sidecar.json`, keeping Node 18/20/22/24 startup uniform. - **Node.js 18 / 20 / earlier 22**: Automatically falls back to the built-in `ProxyConnectAgent`, establishing an HTTP `CONNECT` tunnel (including Basic `Proxy-Authorization` credentials and `NO_PROXY` bypass matching) and upgrading to TLS >= 1.2 with strict certificate verification. - **AES-256-GCM Encrypted Vault**: - Encrypts saved accounts (`vault.enc.json`), automatic pre-switch active-token backups (`last-token.enc.json`), and single-use switch jobs (`jobs/job-.enc.json`) with a local 256-bit random master key (`vault.key`). - Enforces `0700` directory permissions and `0600` file permissions on Unix (WSL2, macOS, and Linux). - **Keep In Menu Bar Adaptive Fast Shutdown & Relaunch**: - Executes switches in a detached worker (`switcher-worker.mjs`: pure Node.js double-fork `--detach-worker` on native Windows outside the `Antigravity.exe` tree, or `systemd-run --user --scope` on Linux/WSL2 when available — zero hidden `powershell.exe` calls). - On **Windows / WSL2**, reads `app_storage.json` (`runInBackground` — Antigravity's *Keep In Menu Bar* setting) and inspects `tasklist /V /FO CSV` to identify visible main `Antigravity.exe` windows, closes them first before cleaning up tray processes (native Windows omits `/T`), and signals WSL2 `language_server` (`SIGTERM`) to flush cleanly. On native Windows, clears the active `gemini:antigravity` Credential Manager entry via `cmdkey.exe` and writes `~/.gemini/jetski-standalone-oauth-token` (which `language_server.exe` imports on startup), then relaunches via `%APPDATA%\Antigravity\launch-env-proxy.vbs` (optional proxy wrapper if present), `Antigravity.exe`, or `ANTIGRAVITY_SWITCHER_RELAUNCH_EXE`. - On **macOS**, quits cleanly via `/usr/bin/osascript` (`SIGTERM` fallback) and relaunches via `/usr/bin/open -a`. - On **Linux**, terminates desktop and `language_server` processes via `SIGTERM` and relaunches the captured desktop binary. - **Pre-Switch Active-Work Guard & Bilingual UI (`中 / EN`)**: - Checks `GetAllCascadeTrajectories`, `ListBackgroundTasks`, and `ListTerminals` via `language_server` RPC plus active user child processes before switching; pauses with **Recheck & Switch**, **Cancel**, or audited **Force Switch** (`FORCE_SWITCH_REQUESTED` in `switch.log`) when work is running. - Built-in instant **`中 / EN`** toggle switches all in-panel UI copy immediately. ## Scope, Boundaries & Known Limitations 1. **Consumer Accounts Only**: Only personal Google accounts (`auth_method: "consumer"`) are supported; enterprise / Google Workspace SSO tokens are rejected. 2. **Restart Required on Switch**: Antigravity holds the active OAuth session in its running `language_server` process, so switching accounts requires quitting Antigravity, waiting for `language_server` to flush and exit, swapping credentials, and relaunching the app. Always finish or acknowledge running tasks before switching. 3. **Platform Verification & Windows Credential Reading**: - **Windows (native)** & **WSL2 + Windows host** have been verified end-to-end on real desktops. On native Windows, this plugin deliberately avoids launching hidden PowerShell/WMI commands to read Credential Manager (preventing security-suite false positives); enroll accounts already signed in on Windows once via **`+ Add Account`**. - **Linux (desktop)** & **macOS** pass full unit/integration CI suites (`ubuntu-latest`, `macos-latest`), while physical macOS desktop GUI switching has not yet been manually tested on real Apple hardware — issue reports and PRs from macOS users are very welcome. 4. **Local Binary Extraction Dependency**: Zero OAuth client secrets are bundled; the plugin extracts client credentials at runtime from your local `language_server` binary. If a future Antigravity update moves the binary or changes its compiled layout, set `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENTAPI_EXE` or use **`Native Sign-in (Fallback)`**. 5. **Static Manifest Display Name**: Antigravity's `plugin.json` and `sidecar.json` currently accept static strings only (no OS-locale manifest switching), so the Plugins manager entry and side-pane tab always display **`Account Switcher`**, while all content inside the panel supports **`中 / EN`** switching. 6. **Quota & Tier Endpoints**: Tier sync and non-active quota views depend on Google Cloud Code endpoints (`v1internal:loadCodeAssist`, `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary`, `30 req/min` rate limit). Upstream API changes or proxy network errors may prevent tier/quota updates while leaving local account switching unaffected. 7. **Independent Community Project**: This is an independent open-source plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. All credentials remain encrypted locally on your machine. ## Requirements - **Node.js >= 18** (`node` binary must be on the `PATH` visible to Antigravity's `language_server`). - **Zero npm packages**: No `npm install` step is required. > **Important `PATH` note for Unix (WSL2 / macOS / Linux):** > Antigravity's `language_server` may run outside your interactive shell environment and might not load `~/.bashrc`, `~/.zshrc`, or `nvm` initialization scripts. Ensure `node` is available on a standard system `PATH` directory (such as `/usr/local/bin/node`, or `/opt/homebrew/bin/node` on macOS if inherited by GUI apps). On Windows, ensure `node.exe` is on your User or System `PATH`. ## Installation ### Option A: Clone Directly into the Global Plugins Folder (Recommended) - **Unix (WSL2 / macOS / Linux)**: ```bash git clone https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-account-switcher ``` - **Windows (PowerShell or CMD)**: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/moon16u/antigravity-account-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-account-switcher" ``` ### Option B: Clone Elsewhere & Register via `plugins.json` 1. Clone this repository into any directory (for example `/path/to/antigravity-plugins/antigravity-account-switcher`). 2. Add the parent directory and `"include_only": ["antigravity-account-switcher"]` to `plugins.json` (merge into existing arrays if present): - **Unix (WSL2 / macOS / Linux)** — `~/.gemini/config/plugins.json`: ```json { "entries": [ { "path": "/path/to/antigravity-plugins", "include_only": [ "antigravity-account-switcher" ] } ] } ``` - **Windows** — `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins.json`: ```json { "entries": [ { "path": "C:\\path\\to\\antigravity-plugins", "include_only": [ "antigravity-account-switcher" ] } ] } ``` 3. **Restart Antigravity** and open the **`Account Switcher`** tab in the right auxiliary pane (also reachable via the **Plugins** page). ## Optional Environment Variables | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` | HTTP proxy and bypass rules for Google OAuth token exchange and Cloud Code requests (lowercase variants also supported). | | `ANTIGRAVITY_SWITCHER_RELAUNCH_EXE` | Custom executable path (or `.vbs` launcher on Windows/WSL2) used to relaunch Antigravity after switching. | | `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENTAPI_EXE` | Overrides the `language_server` binary path used for OAuth client extraction (also used on macOS to locate the `.app` bundle). | | `ANTIGRAVITY_APP_STORAGE_PATH` | Overrides the path to `app_storage.json` (`runInBackground` detection). | | `ANTIGRAVITY_WIN_APPDATA` / `ANTIGRAVITY_WIN_LOCALAPPDATA` | Overrides Windows `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPDATA%` discovery under WSL2 when Windows interop or `PATH` inference is unavailable. | | `ANTIGRAVITY_GEMINI_DIR` / `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR` | Overrides `~/.gemini` and the encrypted sidecar data directory. | ## Runtime Data Directory Runtime data is completely separated from plugin source files. Under Antigravity 2.0 (`ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR`), data lives at `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-account-switcher/switcher/data/` (or `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity\sidecar_data\antigravity-account-switcher\switcher\data\` on Windows; standalone fallback is `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/antigravity-account-switcher/`): - `vault.key` — Randomly generated 256-bit AES master key (`0600` on Unix) - `vault.enc.json` — AES-256-GCM encrypted account vault (`0600` on Unix) - `last-token.enc.json` — AES-256-GCM encrypted backup of the active token captured before switching (`0600` on Unix) - `jobs/job-.enc.json` — Single-use encrypted switch job deleted immediately upon worker pickup - `switch.log` — Sanitized audit and diagnostic log (masked emails and error codes only; never logs tokens or secrets) ## Security Architecture - **Token Gate & Rate Limiting**: All API endpoints require the host-injected `ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_UI_TOKEN` (`403` when absent) and enforce sliding-window rate limits (`60 req/min` reads, `10 req/min` writes, `30 req/min` tier/usage queries) plus a `15s` switch lock. - **Strict CSP & DOM-Safe Frontend**: Responses include `Content-Security-Policy` (`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'`), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and `Permissions-Policy`. The web UI uses `textContent` and DOM builders exclusively (no `innerHTML`, `eval`, or inline scripts/styles). - **Cryptographic Integrity (Fail-Closed)**: Every encrypted envelope uses AES-256-GCM with a unique 12-byte IV and 16-byte authentication tag; any tampering rejects decryption. - **Filesystem & Process Hardening**: Rejects symlinks (`lstatSync`) on sensitive files and directories, enforces path-boundary containment (`assertInsideDir`), writes atomically via temp file + `renameSync`, validates UUIDs, strips prototype-pollution keys (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`), and invokes child processes strictly with argument arrays (`execFileSync` / `spawn`, never `shell: true`). Active-process inspection logs only executable basename + PID to avoid exposing command-line arguments. - **OAuth & Cloud Code Hardening**: Extracts client credentials dynamically from the local signed binary, enforces PKCE S256 + `crypto.timingSafeEqual` single-use `state`, binds callback only on `127.0.0.1:0` with immediate listener teardown, serves static `default-src 'none'` callback pages, enforces TLS >= 1.2 (`rejectUnauthorized: true`), and restricts outbound HTTPS requests strictly to `oauth2.googleapis.com`, `www.googleapis.com`, `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`, and `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`. ## Repository Structure - `plugin.json` — Plugin manifest (`antigravity-account-switcher`, display name `Account Switcher`) - `assets/logo.svg` — Plugin icon - `sidecars/switcher/sidecar.json` — Sidecar entrypoint (`command: "node"`, `args: ["main.mjs"]`, `SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE`) - `sidecars/switcher/main.mjs` — Sidecar HTTP server, API routes, security gates, and rate limiting - `sidecars/switcher/platform.mjs` — Cross-platform runtime detection, path translation, binary discovery, browser launch, and Antigravity relaunch - `sidecars/switcher/binary-oauth.mjs` — ELF64, PE64, and Mach-O 64-bit / Universal Fat binary OAuth client extractor - `sidecars/switcher/oauth.mjs` — PKCE S256 loopback OAuth manager & dual-mode proxy HTTPS client - `sidecars/switcher/cloudcode.mjs` — Subscription tier sync (`loadCodeAssist`), quota summary retrieval (`retrieveUserQuotaSummary` / local LS), and OAuth token refresh helper - `sidecars/switcher/vault.mjs` — AES-256-GCM vault, atomic file writes, symlink/boundary guards, and token normalization - `sidecars/switcher/token-store.mjs` — Cross-platform token store (macOS Keychain & Linux Secret Service keyring, Windows `cmdkey.exe` + file handoff, and WSL2 file store) - `sidecars/switcher/active-work.mjs` — Pre-switch RPC and user child-process detector - `sidecars/switcher/switcher-worker.mjs` — Detached switch and desktop restart worker - `sidecars/switcher/public/` — Auxiliary-pane web UI (`index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`) - `sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs` — Isolated unit and integration test suite ## Running Tests Run the test suite on Node.js >= 18: ```bash node --test sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs ``` On Node.js >= 24.5, also verify native proxy mode with `--use-env-proxy`: ```bash node --use-env-proxy --test sidecars/switcher/test/switcher.test.mjs ``` Run syntax checks across all `.mjs` modules and frontend script: ```bash for f in sidecars/switcher/*.mjs sidecars/switcher/test/*.mjs sidecars/switcher/public/app.js; do node --check "$f"; done ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
